answers.core: I think that a lot of godot users will really use this feature, especially if you're having a lot of animations in you're game.
answers.workaround: There is a workaround that you can set the `Active` property of the AnimationMixer Node inside a script, however this will interfere with your logic if you're already modifying this property at run-time.

title: Add ability to stop the AnimationTree playback inside the editor
